issues.description: Customers report that the app does not accept their password when they try to sign in.
issues.name: Password rejected during login

issues.description: Customers report being unable to get into their account and find the app has too many advertisements.
issues.name: Account access blocked and excessive ads

issues.description: The single review is written in Hinglish and contains abusive language, and it appears to complain about Spotify asking users for money, though the specific billing problem is unclear.
issues.name: Unclear billing complaint with abusive language

issues.description: After an update, free users lose basic controls like choosing specific songs, skipping freely, and replaying tracks unless they pay for premium.
issues.name: Core playback locked behind premium subscription

issues.description: Customers report that many songs they expect are not available in the app's library.
issues.name: Missing songs in catalog

issues.description: Users report that lyrics fail to display for certain songs while appearing for others, making the feature inconsistent.
issues.name: Lyrics missing for some songs

issues.description: Customers report that recommended songs inserted into their own playlists are unwanted, and some feel recommendations have become less relevant or fresh than before.
issues.name: Unwanted or declining music recommendations in playlists

issues.description: Customers report that downloads get stuck in the background and only resume after they manually open the app, which they find frustrating.
issues.name: Background song downloads stall until app reopened

issues.description: Customers report that offline mode or downloaded content fails to work as expected.
issues.name: Offline listening downloads not working

issues.description: Many users express general dissatisfaction with the app and recent updates without specifying a concrete defect, often calling it bad, disappointing, or worth uninstalling.
issues.name: Vague dissatisfaction with recent app updates

issues.description: Premium users report the app cannot connect to the internet over Wi-Fi while mobile data works, and some songs play at poor audio quality.
issues.name: Playback fails on Wi-Fi but works on mobile data

issues.description: Customers report the app crashing on launch or freezing, leaving them unable to open or use it after an update.
issues.name: App crashes and freezes during playback

issues.description: Users report that music does not play, either because voice-assistant playlist requests start without audio or because the app freezes on the loading or logo screen.
issues.name: Playback fails and app stalls on loading

issues.description: Music playback halts partway through a song and does not resume where it left off, instead starting a different track.
issues.name: Playback stops unexpectedly mid-track

issues.description: Users report that the volume of ads, some of them loud, makes the app hard to use without paying for premium.
issues.name: Excessive advertising disrupts app usability

issues.description: Users report general usability frustrations, including ads playing instead of music, audio settings not working properly, and unexpected UX changes that are hard to disable.
issues.name: Confusing usability and intrusive ads

issues.description: Users report that playlists play in random order and that they cannot easily play a single song without going through the whole playlist and facing limited skips.
issues.name: Playlist playback controls frustrate users

issues.description: Customers say a recent Spotify update removed basic music player controls such as repeat, seeking, and skipping back, and reworked the homescreen into a hard-to-use scrolling layout.
issues.name: Recent update removed or disrupted core player features
